$\theta =$
{{field-1}}.
feedback.worked_solution:
The angles that the ray makes with the positive $x$-axis is 

$$
\begin{aligned}\theta  & =\theta =arctan\,(\frac{y}{x}) \\  & =arctan\,(\frac{2}{2}) \\  & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(1) \\  & =\frac{\pi }{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, since the ray lies in the first quadrant, its polar equation is

$$
\theta =\frac{\pi }{4}.
$$
